## Summary

Based on your circumstances, here's your Child Benefit eligibility:

✅ **ELIGIBLE for Alex** - You can claim Child Benefit for Alex, who is 10 years old and lives with you. Even though Alex has been in care for 7 weeks, this is still within the 8-week period during which you can continue to receive Child Benefit.

❌ **NOT ELIGIBLE for Blake** - Blake is 19 years old and not in approved education or training. Child Benefit only continues for 16-19 year olds if they remain in approved education or training.

❌ **NOT ELIGIBLE for Charlie** - Although Charlie is only 2 years old, Charlie doesn't live with you and you're not contributing financially to Charlie's upkeep. The foster parent caring for Charlie would be the appropriate person to claim Child Benefit.

**Important note about Alex:** If Alex remains in care for more than 8 weeks total, your Child Benefit entitlement may change. You should contact HMRC if Alex's care placement continues beyond 8 weeks to discuss your ongoing eligibility.

If you have any questions about this assessment or would like more information, please feel free to ask!
